nodes.label: Day 1 Deck Brief
nodes.rationale: The slide-by-slide plan day-01.html is built from. Every slide names its curriculum section and carries that reference as a visible section-badge.

nodes.label: day-01.html — Day 1 deck (49 slides)
nodes.rationale: Numbers in the brief are the real slide positions in the built deck; the file header count (47) and body note (49 slides) disagree slightly across edits, reflecting ongoing slide merges.

nodes.label: bootcamp_roadmap_and_curriculum.md is the source of truth
nodes.rationale: If the brief and the curriculum ever disagree, the curriculum wins and the brief is wrong.

nodes.label: Day 1 budget: explain 62, demo 62, break 25, own-work 79, review 12
Slide 1 — الغلاف (cover), exact content
nodes.rationale: Dark surface, hero ساج لاب wordmark, presenter block with circular photo, title Eng./م. forced LTR for the Latin name, fact strip (Claude + Claude Code, two weeks Sun-Thu, 40 hours, 10 days), SAG TECH footer lockup, no legal-entity line so Logo_Full.svg is unused.

nodes.label: Slide 3 — رموز الشرائح (slide symbols legend)
nodes.rationale: Bento 2x2: Ctrl/Cmd+click jumps to a section (Backspace returns), hover a dotted underline, i icon for a short term, ؟ icon opens a slide's term window. Must precede slide 6, the first slide that uses these conventions.

nodes.label: section-badge = trainee's route back to the curriculum
nodes.rationale: Every content slide carries a section-badge; it is how a trainee finds the slide again in the guide/curriculum.

nodes.label: Rounded «تقريبًا» durations, no ranges
nodes.rationale: Durations on slides are rounded and prefixed 'approximately', matching the curriculum's own 'estimates are not literal'.

nodes.label: Media referenced from slides/media/, never embedded
nodes.rationale: Keeps the deck file light and the media shared across days.

nodes.label: No slide scrolls — content budget + build-time overflow check
nodes.rationale: <=7 bullets, <=~90 Arabic words, <=8 table rows; over budget splits into ١/٢, ٢/٢; a build-time check fails the build if any slide overflows its frame.

nodes.label: Four-session day structure (62/62/79/12 for Day 1)
nodes.rationale: شرح المفاهيم (explain concepts), تطبيق مع المدرب (trainer-led demo), عمل المتدربين (trainee's own work), مراجعة (review).

nodes.label: Break slides: Day 1 has three, Days 2-10 have two
nodes.rationale: From Day 2 the explain and demo sessions are delivered interleaved (explain a section, play its recording, re-run it live) so there is no transition between them and no break slide; only 'your turn' and 'review' keep theirs. Day 1 is the exception because its demo session is a separate device-setup walkthrough, not a re-run of what was just explained.

nodes.label: Two slides per day carry per-task scaffolding, no repeats elsewhere
nodes.rationale: 'دورك الآن' (anchor your-turn) carries the ready-made copy-paste prompts; 'مراجعة اليوم' (anchor day-review) carries the review checks. Neither is repeated on content slides — the consolidated architecture is deliberate per A.6.2's no-sprawl rule.

nodes.label: Slides 16-18 — حزمة المشروع (package tree + reading split)
nodes.rationale: Slide 16: full 26-line package tree, 13 visible of 26, scrollable, 3 highlighted (trainee-read) rows (slides/, PRODUCT.md, conversation_history.md), reusability note added to the title. Slide 17: four start-here steps (download, unzip, open Claude Code, say hello) with a top bar saying when each runs. Slide 18: split card — what the trainee reads vs what Claude reads, with a ؟ explaining why rules/guides are separate files Claude doesn't ship with by default.

nodes.label: Slide 9 — خريطة المهامّ الكاملة (29-task map, «دورك فيها»)
nodes.rationale: Opens in a wide modal from a ؟ on slide 9's third card; middle column is 'your role in it', not 'who executes it': decide-and-describe (10) / review-and-correct (7) / try-and-adjust (12); every row opens with a verb, never an abstract topic name.

nodes.label: Slide 30 — §7.10 تهيئة أدوات العمل (6+1-step tooling map)
nodes.rationale: 7 items as step-chips in order: Desktop, Claude Code, Git, Antigravity, the extension, Node.js, then the MCP integrations link — Desktop first because it has no prerequisites; Node.js placed as item 6 (not 7) to keep the line clean between trainee-run installs (1-6) and the first thing Claude itself executes (7).

nodes.label: المهمة 14.1 — Create Repo & Scaffold the App (slides 41-43)
nodes.rationale: Slide 41: create the GitHub repo and hand its URL to Claude (github.mp4). Slide 42: Claude builds and tests the app (initial-build.mp4, merged from two old slides, 22 min). Slide 43: verify the first commit & push (push-1.mp4), moved here from slide 45 because the trainer demonstrates it before the trainee's own work session, not after.

nodes.label: stepvid template — one video + scrollable timestamped step list
nodes.rationale: Used throughout §7.10 and task 14.1 slides: a real timestamped step list next to the video, clicking a step jumps and plays the video at that time, and playback auto-highlights and scrolls the matching step (bidirectional sync).

nodes.label: Slide 2 — حزمة المشروع، وصلتكم؟ (quote)
nodes.rationale: Dark quote slide: the package = project logic, rules and context, 'a miniature trainer'. Detail on slides 16-17.

nodes.label: Slide 4 — يومك التدريبي (agenda rows)
nodes.rationale: 5 agenda-row items; no ranges, rounded averages, with 'varies by what we cover'.

nodes.label: Slide 5 — المراجعة ليست جلسة منفصلة (quote)
nodes.rationale: Review is part of the cycle with Claude; it is split out in the table only for planning.

nodes.label: Slide 6 — أجندة اليوم، جلسة شرح المفاهيم
nodes.rationale: 14 items in two columns; checkmarks on what's actually been covered by this slide; notes Day 1 explains longer than later days.

nodes.label: Slide 7 — أجندة اليوم، الجلسات الثلاث الباقية
Slide 8 — أجندة اليوم، أهداف اليوم (bento)
nodes.rationale: Six cards: what each skill achieves today vs what's deferred and to which day.

nodes.label: Slide 9 — الأجندة، مهامّ كل يوم ووين تلقاها
Slide 10 — فهرس المحتويات
nodes.rationale: Top-level headings only (1-17), no subsections.

nodes.label: Slide 11 — كيف نشتغل في الدورة، بنية المنهج
Slide 12 — منهجية العصف الذهني (quote)
nodes.rationale: 'Write everything that comes to mind first, then organize it' — a rule repeated throughout the course.

nodes.label: Slide 13 — نبذة عن الدورة
nodes.rationale: 10 days, 40 hours, a publishable MVP, no deep prior coding experience assumed.

nodes.label: Slide 14 — المهارات ١/٢ (skill cards)
nodes.rationale: 9 cards, no bullet list.

nodes.label: Slide 15 — المهارات ٢/٢ (skill cards)
nodes.rationale: 9 cards; the API-keys card rebuilt: title now names 'API' explicitly, old plain tooltip replaced by a ؟ window with a concrete payment-gateway example.

nodes.label: Slide 19 — ما هو Claude و Claude Code؟
nodes.rationale: Two cards plus the 'cook' example: phoning a cook for the recipe vs the cook entering your kitchen and cooking it himself. 'الطرفية' removed in favour of 'Terminal' with an i tooltip.

nodes.label: Slide 20 — الجلسة وذاكرة Claude
nodes.rationale: Three cards; a ؟ clarifies conversation_history.md is not a Claude feature but a rule the project added in bootcamp-mvp-process.md.

nodes.label: Slide 21 — الرصيد والـtokens ١/٢
nodes.rationale: Defines a token first (an Arabic word = 2-4 tokens, a 300-line file ~= 4000 tokens), then the six consumers in a 4-column grid; one card carries a real Gmail MCP tool description (search_emails) because that's what Claude actually reads.

nodes.label: Slide 22 — الرصيد والـtokens ٢/٢ (stepvid)
nodes.rationale: Converted from an autoplay-loop gifbox to a stepvid to match the rest of the deck's video standard; real 06-desktop-usage.mp4 (13.7s), 4 timestamped steps.

nodes.label: Slide 23 — حدود خطة Pro
nodes.rationale: 5-hour window plus the weekly cap, estimate ~90k tokens (not 'number of messages', which isn't a valid measure).

nodes.label: Slide 24 — ما التكاملات (MCP)؟ ١/٢ (gateway example)
nodes.rationale: A.6.11 gateway example: MCP is never named until the last line. A client email, two numbered sequences (5 manual steps before linking vs 4 after), then the reveal: 'the way this connection happened is called MCP'. Badge deliberately reads 'ربط Claude بأدواتك', not 'التكاملات', so it doesn't spoil the reveal.

nodes.label: Slide 25 — ما التكاملات (MCP)؟ ٢/٢
nodes.rationale: Explains the concept by reflecting it onto the same Gmail example: the tool's three real names, why a standard protocol, the four integrations the course connects, 'only connect what you need'.

nodes.label: Slide 26 — ليش للـMCP تكلفة؟
nodes.rationale: Four steps: the model doesn't remember your tools, every tool's description is attached, Claude reads the tool list before deciding whether one matches the request, and assembly/sending is Claude Code's job (established at slide 21).

nodes.label: Slide 27 — ما المنتج الأولي (MVP)؟
nodes.rationale: Unpacks the acronym Minimum Viable Product.

nodes.label: Slide 28 — سؤالا القسم: الغاية والخاصية
nodes.rationale: Exactly two terms, one meaning each: الغاية (why) and الخاصية (what); scope = features derived from goals, not two independently written lists. All examples are real, from the booking project.

nodes.label: Slide 29 — بداية جلسة تطبيق مع المدرب (quote)
nodes.rationale: Announces the session-type switch; tail card carries no number, like slide 3.

nodes.label: Slide 31 — ١) Claude Desktop (slide-media)
nodes.rationale: Real claude-desktop.mp4 plays in a native <video controls>; three OS download cards (Windows/macOS real buttons, Linux a link + dropdown instructions). 'سقفك' (your ceiling) reworded to 'رصيدك' (your credit).

nodes.label: Slide 32 — ٢) ثبّت Claude Code وسجّل الدخول (stepvid)
nodes.rationale: Merged install+signin slides into one; claude-code.mp4, 8 timestamped steps under two subheadings, two steps devoted to the real PATH-error hiccup.

nodes.label: Slide 33 — ٣) جهّز Git (bento, 3 OS cards)
nodes.rationale: No media here (OS comparison, not a recording): Windows real download button, macOS git --version -> Xcode CLT, Linux verify+install steps.

nodes.label: Slide 34 — ٣) من التثبيت إلى ضبط الهويّة (stepvid, merged video)
nodes.rationale: Single merged git-setup.mp4 (git.mp4 + git-auth.mp4 via ffmpeg concat); identity section rebuilt to 8 steps walking the browser step by step, matching the shot list's re-shot git-auth.mp4.

nodes.label: Slide 35 — ٤) ثبّت Antigravity وجهّزه للعمل (stepvid)
nodes.rationale: Merged three old slides into one; antigravity-ide.mp4, 12 timestamped steps under 4 subheadings including the newly-documented mobile QR verification step.

nodes.label: Slide 36 — ٥) أضِف إضافة Claude Code وقل السلام عليكم (stepvid)
nodes.rationale: claude-code-extension.mp4; 6 steps including the undocumented 'trust the publisher' prompt; first slide to explain CLAUDE.md §أ.1/أ.2's self-introduction logic in full, with a stepvid__fix noting Node.js and the project-idea question still pending after this step.

nodes.label: Slide 37 — ٦) ثبّت Node.js (stepvid)
nodes.rationale: node-js.mp4; grew from 6 to 8 steps after filming, including the license-agreement click and two new steps (ask Claude to verify; review via conversation_history.md instead of the chat panel).

nodes.label: Slide 38 — ٧أ) اربط chrome-devtools (stepvid)
nodes.rationale: New section, moved here from task 14.2 once initial-build.mp4 showed chrome-devtools is used from Day 1; chrome-devtools.mp4 (0:29), the one integration the trainee types himself because the install command is interactive.

nodes.label: Slide 39 — ٧ب) ربط context7 (stepvid)
nodes.rationale: context7-redacted.mp4 (1:49); 6 steps; blurred 0:56-1:46 over a real API key.

nodes.label: Slide 40 — ٧ج) أنشئ مشروع Supabase واربط الـMCP (stepvid)
nodes.rationale: Fully re-recorded supabase.mp4 (3:22); 11 steps under two subheadings; new real steps include Claude proposing the project name and the one-time MCP trust prompt.

nodes.label: Slide 44 — بداية جلسة: عملك على مشروعك (quote)
nodes.rationale: New slide; Day 1 is the only day with a break slide before the own-work session, since explain/demo stay separate only on Day 1.

nodes.label: Slide 45 — دورك الآن، هيّئ جهازك وشغّل تطبيقك
nodes.rationale: Replaces two old scattered 'your turn' card slides with no task numbers or links; two columns breaking 7.10 into 7 sub-items + 3 MCP items, and 14.1 into its sub-steps, each row data-anchor linked back to its slide.

nodes.label: Slide 46 — بداية جلسة: مراجعة وعرض التقدم (quote)
nodes.rationale: New slide, same break-slide rule.

nodes.label: Slide 47 — مراجعة اليوم (slide-closing)
nodes.rationale: Success criterion: your app runs + login opens; 'تطبيقك يشتغل' now points to slide 42's 'run it on your machine' section.

nodes.label: Slide 48 — إن بقي لديك وقت
nodes.rationale: No dedicated time: start collecting notes on your project idea (task 8.1).

nodes.label: Slide 49 — غدًا (slide-closing)
nodes.rationale: Preview of Day 2: defining the project, its scope and its users; rebuilt into cards and corrected 'تكاملاك' (dual) to 'تكاملاتك الثلاثة' (three integrations).
